summary: Completed frontend testing of video gallery integration feature. Video thumbnails now appear in project detail pages for projects with video_url, clicking opens lightbox with YouTube iframe (autoplay enabled). Gallery count correctly includes video. Tested on homeland-regalia, cp67, and homeland-heights projects. Regression tests confirm Overview tab has no duplicate video embed and image thumbnails still function correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Enquiry form modal occasionally interferes with lightbox interactions during automated testing. Escape key doesn't always close lightbox on first press when multiple modals are present.
integration_issues.impact: Minor - affects automated testing only, not user experience in normal usage
integration_issues.workaround: Use force clicks or multiple Escape presses in tests

passed_tests: Video thumbnail appears with data-testid='detail-video-thumb' (gold play icon + 'VIDEO' label)
Clicking video thumbnail opens lightbox with iframe (title='Project video')
Video iframe src includes autoplay=1 parameter
Gallery button count correctly shows total media count (images + video)
Bottom label in lightbox shows 'Video' for video slide
Video feature works on multiple projects: homeland-regalia (6 items), cp67, homeland-heights
REGRESSION PASS: Overview tab has NO video iframe (no duplication)
REGRESSION PASS: Image thumbnails still change hero image with active state (gold border)

success_percentage.frontend: 95% - All core video gallery features working correctly. Minor modal interference during automated testing does not affect user experience.
